verdicts.reason: A is clean and has no collisions, but the headline is too small for a 768-wide banner. The '7 days free' fine print is so tiny it can't be read, and a large dead gap separates the text block from the CTA, which is stranded at the far right. B gets the hierarchy right with a big headline, but it is badly cramped: the headline sits against the top edge, the fine print against the bottom, and the phone is clipped at the right edge and touches the top and bottom. The CTA also floats off-centre and doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline or fine print.
